Fancy lunch
Sep 2019
The restaurant was located in a big street in Hanoi with ground floor to park cars or scooter. It was at the top of the building with the view to the lake and another side, the view was to the city. It was cool with those view. We wanted to see more so instead of staying where the elevator stopped, we took the stairs to go up 1 more story. There were many people there, many of them just ordered a dessert just to take pictures. I guess that was a normal thing in Hanoi. We were there for lunch. The waiter brought us dirty forks and knives at the first place then they changed them after we claimed that. Bread was crunchy but butter smelled like nothing and didn't taste like butter. Sweet corn soup with shrimp was nice but I didn't really like the part when they left the whole big shrimp with tail on my soup. Beef salad was fresh and rice with long hour cooked ribs tasted nice. Piña colada tasted a little bit wrong with no smell and taste of coconut. The staff was nice but seems like they spent a lot of time talking to each other. Price was high because there were many kind of costs added I guess.

Jun 2019 • Friends
I've been wanting to try this place for a while. After all, it has absolutely amazing views of West Lake. And, it really does have great facilities. There are at least three floors of the restaurant with bar, child play area, and indoor/outdoor dining. We spent the first part of the evening indoors. And, although I've seen some complaints about the service, we had good service!
